notes.title: [Pre-recorded] Punk Juice demo playthrough w/ the developers!
notes.notes: [p]This broadcast is pre-recorded! [/p][p][/p][p]Seattle punk band LEMON BOY and the developers of Punk Juice play through their free demo![/p]

notes.title: We're not dead!!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hey y'all!! [/b][/h1]

We want u to know that we are [b]NOT dead[/b] and we've been working really hard!! We added a few screenshots to show off some new features we've finished in the past couple months! Stay tuned for a new trailer dropping soon... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831340/51f3839edd6fa435212631fd08a4e6b17e2ce43a.png[/img]

[h1]Skating![/h1]

Roll around town and explore different neighborhoods using your skates! Rumor has it you'll be able to change those to match your cute outfits...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831340/370ed447d0849bf08114c8a4f4e732c009244384.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831340/977bc90929697d7adf7b06bbae69cc88604797b7.png[/img]

[h1]Public Transit![/h1]

Get around town using the bus and enjoy the scenery between locations!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831340/d643b693e83be162c2de7e85d45804a09bd4b3f2.png[/img]
[h1]New Shops![/h1]

Not only can you buy coffee, but gear and knick knacks at the thrift store and new music shops! Check the shop daily for new pieces of clothing to stash in your closet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831340/78a4bef8fc1bc8e4b5ed9bb168cc056e995e0872.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831340/b139d39cc2d1c890e314800ffadb9f3d31983d11.png[/img]

[h1]New Gigs![/h1]

Battle your rivals at local venues! No stage is too big or too small for your punk presence!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831340/686747b4671f055f2741c68c640239793f02db6c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831340/f0824a429ed2406cac65270bd0b2b5d4f6febe8c.png[/img]

[h3]We've got more info [url=https://linktr.ee/lemonboyband]here[/url] if ur hungry for more punk juice / lemon boy updates! <3[/h3]
